name: reloscope
description: Explore complex relationship graphs and trace every claim back to evidence.

interface.longDescription: Reloscope turns complex entity and relationship data into an interactive visual map. Search entities, expand neighborhoods, trace paths, and inspect the evidence behind each relationship without leaving the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Turn the relationships in this conversation into an interactive graph.
Trace the strongest path between two entities.
Explain the evidence behind this relationship.
